correctness.rationale: The binary membership vector satisfies A x=b1+(a-b)x with mean b/(4-a+b); after mean removal every nontrivial root of unity frequency obeys P_lambda(z)=z^6+z^4+z²+1-lambda z³. Exact cyclotomic orders are lambda=-4:2; -1:5,6; 0:4,8; 1:3,10. Binary separability of sums of coprime-period components plus integral density eliminates mixed 5/6 and 3/10 alternatives. For lambda=0, period 8 or 4 follows; direct residue-neighbor counts give the exhaustive formula 2[2|n]+6[3|n]+30[5|n]+68[8|n]+4[n≡4 mod8]. Independently enumerated all labelled proper subsets for n=7..18 and matched each (a,b) count; T(120)=106 and the bound/equality follow from divisibility without relying on a finite n cutoff.
